A '''Seneschal''' was a position in the royal houses of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]].

[[Sival Brentioch]] was the seneschal of [[House Brentaal]], while at the same time was able to act as his own errand boy as a disguise.

==Behind the scenes==
The title of [[Wikipedia:seneschal|seneschal]] is a historical title used by the houses of nobles during the Middle Ages in Europe, usually referring to an officer with responsibilities similar to that of a [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]]. Occasionally the title would refer to an officer with judicial or military administration.
